sentiment.rationale: The document reports that Netflix raised its full-year revenue forecast to $44.8-$45.2 billion from $43.5-$44.5 billion, a meaningful upward revision of the company's own prior guidance. This forward-looking raise, combined with an earnings beat (EPS $7.19 vs. forecast $7.03) and accelerating member growth, justifies a positive score. The slight after-hours dip is attributed to elevated expectations, not to any reduction in guidance or cautious language.
